content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: First class Post Graduation degree; Second class Post Graduation degree including integrated PG degree with PhD Experience: Desirable: one year of work experience from a recognized institution Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: Proficiency in computer applications and data management (desirable) Fluent in English and Hindi languages (desirable) Qualifications and experience should be in the relevant discipline and from an institution of repute Experience must have been gained after obtaining the minimum essential qualification Desirable: MDS (Public Health Dentistry) / MD (Community Medicine) / MPH (Masters in Public Health) from a recognized university One year of work experience from a recognized institution Experience in research work in the field of Public Health

faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical).

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form attached to the notice (pages 3 to 5)) and send it to Department of Public Health Dentistry, King George's Medical University, Lucknow, by speed post, registered post or by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.
